task: Open `/home/user/Documents/reference.ply` and `/home/user/Documents/misaligned.ply` in CloudCompare. Register the point cloud in `misaligned.ply` to the coordinate frame of `reference.ply`, and save the resulting aligned cloud as `/home/user/Documents/aligned.ply` in ASCII PLY format. Export only the aligned cloud. The result should still contain 1200 points and should closely match the spatial extent of the reference cloud (approximately x in [-2.2, 5.2], y in [-2.2, 2.2], z in [-2.2, 2.2]).
task_grounding: Open /home/user/Documents/reference.ply and /home/user/Documents/misaligned.ply in CloudCompare. Both are ASCII PLYs with 1200 points; misaligned.ply is the same object as reference.ply but rotated ~10 degrees around Z and translated roughly by (2, 1, 0.5). Select misaligned.ply as the 'to-be-aligned' (compared) entity and reference.ply as the reference, then run Tools > Registration > Fine registration (ICP) with default options to align misaligned.ply onto reference.ply. After ICP finishes, export the aligned (compared) cloud as an ASCII PLY at /home/user/Documents/aligned.ply (File > Save). Do not export the reference cloud. The aligned cloud must have 1200 points and its bounding box must fall within the bounds of the reference cloud (approximately x in [-2.2, 5.2], y in [-2.2, 2.2], z in [-2.2, 2.2]).

verification.description: Aligned cloud has the same 1200 points
Aligned cloud bbox falls within reference cloud bbox

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: cli-anything-cloudcompare export cloud INDEX output.ply --preset ply [--overwrite]
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI has 'export cloud' command supporting multiple formats (PLY binary/ASCII, LAS, XYZ, etc.) with format-specific options.
